title: Guess the engine
author: kernet
selftext:
After receiving moderate hare in here a while ago I kept going and never gave up.

Idea: bring AAA mobile game experience with everything I loved in different movile game genres (autochess / TFT, casual tower defense for normies in both single & multiplayer, roguelite, CCGs). My vision is to deliver long-lived live service game where there are going to be new card releases every two weeks. Satisfying for cars collection enthusiasts, yet grindy enough for farmers and competitive enough for ambitios players. Easy to pick-up and hard to master!

Background story  
Having fair coding background (never made game mayself, my peak was custom Java plugins for bukkit minecraft servers back in 2010), zero art experience and talent and zero animation knowledge, current state of AI has been a breath of fresh air for me.

All art and 2D concepts for characters has been done by codex imagegen. Models, rigs and animations are made with Tripo 3D and Blender MCP pipeline orchestrated by Opus and Astra for micro finetuning parts. **Guess the engine in the comments!**

Whole UI and HUD is pure React. Builds for iOS and Android are done in Capacitor with some native adapters for store integration and partly backend communication.

Backend is region split runners based on Socket.IO custom lightweight implementation optimized for this game rules. Server authoritative.

Roast me again, please :)

Out for Android, soon on iOS.

https://starvoxel.com
